lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters exhibit a semi-regular spatial distribution posterior to the five vertical gill slits. The arrangement displays a shift from high-density clustering on the mid-flank to more linear, horizontal alignments as they move posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs on the posterior lateral surface, forming a rudimentary grid-like spatial arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light-weighted values on the dorsal edge and a localized shadow gradient below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) attached to the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin's insertion point.
